description: SPECULATE RECORDS: a holder signs a record about their own wallet, one of two kinds named by program. speculative-open-holding: you sign that you read the plain-words holding disclosure, naming its version and its hash (net_speculate_status gives both); the words say that holding NET is speculative, can lose value and promises no return, and that the house sells nothing and pays nothing. future-work-forward: you note a NONBINDING interest in one kind of work, in one city and one quarter; nothing is reserved, promised, queued, priced or owed by it, and it is never a claim on a job. A place is a city and a state, never an address. Each needs your own statement, never assumed for you: acknowledges true, or nonbinding true. You choose the record's id; the same id and the same terms read the record back. commit makes the record; withdraw ends your own record at any time, even while the NET programs are stopped. A record is never needed to hold NET, claim a job, vote or work. FREE, a signed statement, no fee, no gas. The programs are built but held off until the operator switches the NET programs on together: until then a new record is refused before you sign, and a withdrawal only works on a record that exists. This moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing in it. Never put a phone number, an email or a street address in any field. Refusals that depend on this wallet's own records are answered only when you submit, so prepare never says which wallet holds what: the wallet may already hold an open acknowledgement of these words, or the same open interest (the same kind of work, city and quarter), or the most open interests one wallet may hold, or the record id may already be in use with other terms. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the holder wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_net_speculate within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

acknowledges.description: commit, speculative-open-holding: true is YOUR statement that you read the disclosure. It is never assumed for you.

act.description: commit a new record, or withdraw one you hold.

city.description: commit, future-work-forward: the name of one city, plain letters only. Never an address or a place pin.

disclosureSha256.description: commit, speculative-open-holding: the 64-character lowercase hash of the disclosure you read.

disclosureVersion.description: commit, speculative-open-holding: the version of the disclosure you read (net_speculate_status with view disclosure).

nonbinding.description: commit, future-work-forward: true is YOUR statement that this record reserves, promises, queues, prices and owes nothing. It is never assumed for you.

period.description: commit, future-work-forward: a quarter that has not ended and is at most eight quarters ahead, such as 2027-Q2.

principal.description: The 0x… address that signs: the holder's wallet. Address only, never a private key.

program.description: commit: which record this is. speculative-open-holding is the acknowledgement of the disclosure; future-work-forward is the nonbinding interest in a kind of work.

reason.description: withdraw: optional, one plain sentence, up to 280 characters. Only you ever read it back.

recordId.description: The record's id: 1 to 80 letters, numbers and . _ : -. You choose it when you commit; the same id and the same terms read the record back.

state.description: commit, future-work-forward: the two-letter US state code (or DC), for example CA.

workKind.description: commit, future-work-forward: a work type from the board's own library, lower case with underscores (the work_type of any job on the board).

name: prepare_net_speculate
title: Make or end your own NET holding record: a disclosure acknowledgement or a nonbinding work interest (step 1 of 2)
